backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing fuel station management with user profiles, tanks, sales, expenses, staff, shifts, cash collections, price updates, and Stripe payment integration. Includes authorization/access control and HTTP outcalls.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that StaffManagement component should enable 'Add New Staff Member' button for Admin (Owner) role in addition to Manager role.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON summary of frontend component files describing their functionality, including StaffManagement which allows both Owners and Managers to add staff with role-based access control.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and OKLCH color system variables defining light and dark theme design tokens for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Fuel Inventory Management application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with TanStack Router setup, authentication guard using Internet Identity, profile setup flow, and route definitions for all dashboard pages.
frontend/src/components/AlertsPanel.tsx: Displays active and resolved tank refill alerts, showing tanks below threshold with details on current level, refill needed, and links to update tank levels.
Visual analytics using Recharts to display sales trends over time, fuel type revenue/volume comparisons, and transaction counts with line and bar charts.
frontend/src/components/CashCollectionEn: Component for recording daily cash collections with form input for amount and breakdown, displaying today's sales vs cash collected with discrepancy calculation, and showing a table of all cash collection records.
frontend/src/components/CommissionCalcul: Component that calculates and displays staff commissions based on sales performance, showing a breakdown table with sales count, total sales, commission rate, and earned commission for each staff member.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard component displaying overview cards for active alerts, current shift status, today's sales revenue, and tank status with clickable links to detailed views.
Layout wrapper component with sidebar navigation for all main sections (tanks, sales, shifts, reports, etc.), admin-only menu items, and user profile/logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseLogger.ts: Component for logging and tracking operational expenses by category (maintenance, electricity, salaries, supplies) with form input and table display of all expense records with category totals.
frontend/src/components/FuelTypeAnalytic: Analytics component comparing petrol vs diesel performance metrics including volume sold, revenue, transaction count, and average sale value with percentage breakdowns.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that handles Internet Identity authentication, toggling between login and logout states, and clearing the query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/PaymentFailure.t: Displays a failure message card with an error icon when a payment is cancelled or fails, providing a button to return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSuccess.t: Displays a success message card with a checkmark icon when a payment is processed successfully, providing a button to return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PriceUpdateModul: Admin-only component for updating fuel prices (petrol/diesel) and viewing current prices and price history in a table format.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: A form component for new users to complete their profile by entering name, phone number, and selecting a staff role (owner, manager, operator, or attendant).
frontend/src/components/ProfitLossDashbo: Displays financial metrics including total revenue, expenses, net profit/loss, and profit margin with breakdowns for petrol and diesel sales.
frontend/src/components/SalesForm.tsx: A form for recording new fuel sales transactions with fuel type selection, quantity input, staff member selection, and automatic total calculation based on current prices.
frontend/src/components/SalesReports.tsx: Displays sales analytics with daily/weekly/monthly tabs showing total revenue, fuel-type breakdowns, and volume metrics for petrol and diesel sales.
React component for managing staff shifts, allowing users to start and end shifts, view active shift details including sales count, and select staff members from a dropdown.
frontend/src/components/ShiftReport.tsx: Displays comprehensive shift reports in a table format showing shift details, staff names, timestamps, sales counts, and revenue with fuel type breakdowns (petrol/diesel).
Manages staff members with add/remove functionality, role assignment, commission rate configuration, and permission checks for admin/manager access.
frontend/src/components/StockReconciliat: Reconciles daily fuel stock by comparing calculated closing stock (opening + purchases - sales) against actual closing stock and highlights variances for each tank.
frontend/src/components/TankMonitor.tsx: Monitors fuel tank levels with visual progress indicators, allows updating tank volumes and adding new tanks with capacity, threshold, and fuel type configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, tanks, sales, expenses, staff, shifts, cash collections, price updates, and shopping items with mutations and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors using OKLCH color space, including sidebar, chart, and UI component tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration with custom theme extensions for OKLCH colors, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a fuel station management system with multi-module architecture, known issues in staff management (add staff error and missing commission rate field), and comprehensive feature tracking across inventory, sales, staff, finance, and analytics modules.
